answer_text: For the three months ended June 30, 2026, the compensation expense allocated to CCB was $815 million, to CIB was $1.2 billion, and to AWM was $287 million. For the same period in 2025, the compensation expense allocated to CCB was $785 million, to CIB was $1.1 billion, and to AWM was $272 million [2].
